label: Kost Cove
note: Simple LFB two-storey Cove kost (preview). Based on the old procedural Cove facade (vo-mp/ind/p_cove.py, virtual-office/index.html): grey-white walls, five numbered windows, glass door, COVE KOST sign, thin canopy. Footprint and collision match pipeline:id200_bangunan_rumah_kos_dua_lantai so the lot and street use tile (-27, 71) stay valid. Glass door is centred on the south facade (c=2.75) at that use tile. Windows 4–5 glow for Ichsan and Noor; 1–3 stay dark/locked. sw/se/ne/nw. Preview only.
